title: Concept: Laravel Telescope dashboard disclosed
description: Telescope keeps full request and job payloads, including the headers and the mail bodies, and renders them in the dashboard. Reaching it publishes the traffic of the application, not just its configuration.
applicability: Responses from a Laravel application that ships Telescope outside the local environment.
risk: The caller reads request payloads, mail bodies and job arguments, which usually include credentials and personal data.
